seo.title: Best Brunch Cafes in Seoul (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Seoul's top brunch cafes for 2026! From trendy Australian spots to classic American diners and healthy options, find your perfect weekend meal in Gangnam, Itaewon, and more. Your ultimate guide to Seoul brunch.

hero.subtitle: Seoul's brunch scene is a vibrant blend of international flavors and local charm, offering everything from classic American comfort food to trendy Australian-inspired dishes and healthy, modern options across its diverse neighborhoods.

picks.name: Bills (빌즈)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Originating from Sydney, Bills brings a taste of sunny Australia to Seoul with its bright, airy interiors and fresh, high-quality ingredients. Known for its laid-back luxury and innovative dishes, it's a perfect spot for a relaxed yet sophisticated brunch. The atmosphere is consistently cheerful and inviting, making it a popular choice for both locals and expats.
picks.whatToOrder: Ricotta Hotcakes with fresh banana and honeycomb butter
picks.insiderTip: Reservations are highly recommended, especially on weekends, as wait times can be substantial. Try their freshly squeezed juices.
picks.redditQuote: "Bills' ricotta hotcakes are seriously life-changing. I thought it was just hype, but nope, they're the real deal. Worth every penny for that perfect fluffy bite!"

picks.name: Cafe Mamas (카페마마스)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A beloved local chain, Cafe Mamas is celebrated for its fresh, wholesome menu featuring generous portions of salads, sandwiches, and paninis. It’s known for its commitment to fresh ingredients and homemade feel, offering a comforting and satisfying brunch experience. The atmosphere is generally bustling and casual, perfect for a quick yet healthy meal.
picks.whatToOrder: Ricotta Cheese Salad and Green Grape Juice
picks.insiderTip: Order at the counter and be prepared for a lively, often busy environment. Grab a seat quickly during peak hours.
picks.redditQuote: "Cafe Mamas is my go-to for a reliable, healthy brunch in Seoul. The ricotta salad is huge and the grape juice is so refreshing. It never disappoints!"

picks.name: The Original Pancake House (오리지널팬케이크하우스)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Bringing authentic American breakfast culture to Seoul, The Original Pancake House in Garosu-gil is famous for its massive, fluffy pancakes, waffles, and various egg dishes. With a retro diner ambiance, it's a nostalgic spot perfect for those craving a hearty, traditional brunch. Expect generous portions and classic comfort food.
picks.whatToOrder: Dutch Baby Pancake or Apple Pancake
picks.insiderTip: Come hungry! The portions are substantial. They have unique pancake styles not found elsewhere in Seoul.
picks.redditQuote: "If you miss American pancakes, The Original Pancake House in Garosu-gil is the closest you'll get. The Dutch Baby is incredible, but bring friends to share!"

picks.name: Butterfingers Pancake (버터핑거스 팬케이크)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A long-standing favorite in Gangnam, Butterfingers Pancake offers an extensive menu of American-style brunch staples, from towering pancake stacks to savory omelets and crispy bacon. Its casual, bustling atmosphere makes it a popular weekend destination. It’s perfect for satisfying those cravings for a classic, indulgent brunch experience.
picks.insiderTip: This spot can get very crowded, especially on Sunday mornings. Be prepared for a wait or visit during off-peak hours.
picks.redditQuote: "Butterfingers Pancake is the OG American brunch spot in Gangnam. Their Big Fat Brunch plate is legendary – seriously, it's enough food for two people. So good."

picks.name: Cafe Layered (카페 레이어드)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled in the charming Anguk area, Cafe Layered is renowned for its picturesque, vintage-inspired interior and an irresistible array of freshly baked scones, cakes, and other pastries. While not a traditional full-service brunch, its delightful ambiance and excellent baked goods make it an ideal spot for a light, aesthetic brunch experience. It's a hugely popular photo spot.
picks.whatToOrder: Classic Scone with clotted cream and jam, and an Iced Latte
picks.insiderTip: Go early to avoid long queues, especially for getting a table inside. Take advantage of the beautiful setting for photos.
picks.redditQuote: "Cafe Layered is pure Instagram heaven. Their scones are amazing, and the vibe in Anguk is just perfect for a chill morning. Always busy, but worth it."

picks.name: One In A Million (원인어밀리언)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: With its iconic pink and white minimalist aesthetic, One In A Million in Hannam-dong is a hotspot for trendy brunch-goers. It offers a selection of beautifully plated light brunch items, pastries, and exceptional coffee. The cafe is less about hearty meals and more about enjoying a chic atmosphere with elegantly crafted drinks and snacks, perfect for a relaxed gathering.
picks.insiderTip: Be prepared for a crowd, especially on weekends. It's a great spot for photos, both indoors and in their charming outdoor seating area.
picks.redditQuote: "One In A Million in Hannam is super cute, great for a light bite and a photoshoot. Their pink latte is definitely worth trying, even if it's just for the gram!"

picks.name: Sunday Arvo (선데이 아보)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Another slice of Australian brunch culture in Hannam-dong, Sunday Arvo offers a diverse menu with fresh, vibrant dishes and excellent coffee. It boasts a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere, reminiscent of a casual Sunday afternoon ('arvo' is Aussie slang for afternoon). Their menu often features seasonal ingredients and creative twists on classic brunch fare, making it a reliable favorite.
picks.whatToOrder: French Toast with Berries and Mascarpone or the Avo Smash
picks.insiderTip: They have a lovely outdoor seating area perfect for people-watching on a pleasant day. It's often less crowded than Bills but equally delicious.
picks.redditQuote: "Sunday Arvo is my favorite Hannam brunch spot when Bills is too packed. Their French toast is heavenly, and the coffee is top-notch. Very chill vibe."

picks.name: LOWIDE (로우아이드)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located in the trendy Seongsu district, LOWIDE embodies minimalist chic with its industrial-inspired interior and focus on high-quality coffee and simple, elegant brunch dishes. It's a perfect spot for those who appreciate understated aesthetics and carefully crafted food and beverages. The atmosphere is calm and sophisticated, ideal for a quiet morning.
picks.insiderTip: Explore the surrounding Seongsu area after your meal; it's full of unique boutiques and art spaces. LOWIDE's coffee is particularly renowned.
picks.redditQuote: "If you're in Seongsu, LOWIDE is a must for coffee lovers. Their simple brunch menu complements the excellent coffee perfectly, and the aesthetic is just *chef's kiss*."

picks.name: Little Nap Coffee & Brunch (리틀냅 커피 & 브런치)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Tucked away in Hapjeong, Little Nap offers a wonderfully cozy and inviting atmosphere, making it feel like a hidden gem. It specializes in homemade-style brunch dishes, from fluffy omelets to delicious sandwiches, paired with carefully brewed coffee. The rustic, comfortable interior provides a relaxing escape from the city bustle.
picks.whatToOrder: Eggs Benedict and their signature Drip Coffee
picks.insiderTip: Finding it can be a little tricky as it's off the main street, adding to its charm. It's a great spot for a relaxed, unhurried brunch.
picks.redditQuote: "Little Nap in Hapjeong is such a cute, comfy place. Their Eggs Benedict is consistently good, and the coffee is always on point. Perfect for a lazy Sunday."

picks.name: Brunch Cafe 707 (브런치 카페 707)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A popular spot among students and locals in the vibrant Hongdae area, Brunch Cafe 707 serves up straightforward, satisfying brunch fare at reasonable prices. Known for its generous portions and comfortable, unpretentious setting, it's a reliable choice for classic brunch dishes like omelets, pancakes, and French toast. It offers a lively and youthful atmosphere.
picks.insiderTip: It's a great value for money in the Hongdae area. Expect it to be busy with a younger crowd, especially during lunchtime.
picks.redditQuote: "Brunch Cafe 707 is my go-to when I'm in Hongdae and craving a solid, no-frills brunch. Their portions are huge for the price, and it's always buzzing."

picks.name: Thanks, Oat (땡스오트)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: For a wholesome and health-conscious brunch, Thanks, Oat in Sinsa-dong is a standout. This cafe specializes in delicious and beautifully presented oat-based dishes, including various oatmeal bowls, overnight oats, and granolas, with plenty of fresh fruit toppings and vegan options. It offers a bright, clean, and refreshing atmosphere, perfect for a guilt-free start to your day.
picks.whatToOrder: Any of their Signature Oat Bowls with fresh fruit
picks.insiderTip: They offer customizable toppings and milk alternatives, catering well to dietary restrictions. It's a great spot for a lighter, nutritious meal.
picks.redditQuote: "Finally found a healthy brunch spot in Seoul that actually tastes good! Thanks, Oat in Sinsa has amazing oat bowls, so fresh and colorful. My vegan friends loved it too."

picks.name: Mamacita's (마마시타스)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Mamacita's offers a unique take on brunch with its vibrant Mexican-fusion menu in the lively Itaewon district. Expect creative taco combinations, flavorful huevos rancheros, and refreshing brunch cocktails in a colorful, upbeat setting. It’s perfect for those seeking something beyond traditional brunch, with a lively ambiance that truly stands out.
picks.whatToOrder: Breakfast Burrito or Huevos Rancheros with a Michelada
picks.insiderTip: This place is great for groups and has a lively atmosphere. Don't miss their brunch cocktails for a real weekend treat.
picks.redditQuote: "Mamacita's in Itaewon is such a vibe for brunch! Their breakfast burritos are massive and so flavorful, and their micheladas hit different. Definitely a fun spot."

faq.question: What's the typical price range for brunch in Seoul?
faq.answer: Brunch in Seoul generally ranges from ₩10,000 to ₩40,000 ($8 to $30) per person. Budget-friendly cafes might offer dishes around ₩10,000-₩15,000, while more upscale or international brunch spots typically charge ₩20,000-₩35,000 or more per plate, not including drinks.

faq.question: Which neighborhoods are best for brunch in Seoul?
faq.answer: Popular neighborhoods for brunch include Gangnam (Sinsa-dong/Garosu-gil), Itaewon, Hannam-dong, Hongdae, and Seongsu-dong. Each area offers a distinct vibe, from trendy and international to artistic and local, ensuring a wide variety of brunch experiences.

faq.question: Do I need reservations for brunch cafes in Seoul?
faq.answer: For popular brunch cafes, especially on weekends, reservations are highly recommended, or be prepared for a wait. Places like Bills or Cafe Layered can have long queues. For smaller, local spots, walk-ins are usually fine, but arriving early is always a good strategy.

faq.question: Are there vegetarian or vegan-friendly brunch options in Seoul?
faq.answer: Yes, Seoul's brunch scene is increasingly accommodating dietary preferences. Many cafes offer vegetarian options like salads, avocado toast, and egg dishes. Dedicated spots like Thanks, Oat specialize in plant-based meals, and most cafes can modify dishes upon request, though it's always best to check beforehand.

faq.question: What time do most brunch cafes open in Seoul?
faq.answer: Most brunch cafes in Seoul typically open between 9:00 AM and 10:30 AM. Some may open earlier, especially those catering to early risers or coffee lovers. Weekend hours are usually consistent, but it's always a good idea to check specific cafe hours online before visiting.

faq.question: Is it common for brunch cafes to have good coffee in Seoul?
faq.answer: Absolutely! Seoul is a global leader in coffee culture, and most brunch cafes pride themselves on serving high-quality coffee, from specialty roasts to expertly prepared espresso drinks. Many brunch spots are also renowned coffee shops, ensuring your caffeine fix is as satisfying as your meal.

methodology: Our experts scoured Seoul's most dynamic districts, sampling dozens of establishments known for their unique menus, inviting atmospheres, and consistent quality. We prioritized venues offering diverse culinary experiences, from traditional brunch fare to innovative twists, considering both local favorites and international hotspots to curate this definitive list.
